components.name: Project Card
components.description: Board-layer card with a fiducial-framed cover; copper border on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 320px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; text-align: left; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(237,232,222,0.09)); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--bg-elevated, #14120f); transition: border-color 300ms, transform 300ms; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(201,125,79,0.5); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-hover, #e29a6c); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-card-cover { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16/10; background: var(--bg-surface, #1b1814); } .ds-fid { position: absolute; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 0 solid var(--accent, #c97d4f); } .ds-fid-tl { left: 12px; top: 12px; border-left-width: 2px; border-top-width: 2px; } .ds-fid-tr { right: 12px; top: 12px; border-right-width: 2px; border-top-width: 2px; } .ds-fid-bl { left: 12px; bottom: 12px; border-left-width: 2px; border-bottom-width: 2px; } .ds-fid-br { right: 12px; bottom: 12px; border-right-width: 2px; border-bottom-width: 2px; } .ds-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 24px; } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary, #b5ad9f); margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent-hover, #e29a6c); } .ds-card-title { font: 600 20px 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--text-primary, #ede8de); } .ds-card-text { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--text-secondary, #b5ad9f); }

narrative.overview:
The page is a working circuit board. The ground is matte solder-mask black with a faint static noise, layered in two slightly warmer tones. Copper is the only colour that acts: traces, filled pads for primary actions, the active state. Every small label is silkscreen, set in mono, and it always carries real data (a count, a date, a live time, a last push), never a category name.

On wide screens (xl and up) one copper trace leaves the hero board on a square pad, runs down the left margin through every section, lights a ring via level with each heading, fills with scroll, and terminates by bending onto the contact email pad. Images sit inside fiducial corner marks like a board waiting for the pick-and-place machine. Type is Archivo: expanded to its widest axis for display, like equipment lettering, and normal width for reading.

The system is flat and precise: hairline rules instead of boxes, 2px corners, no glass, no glow halos, no decorative shadows. It explicitly refuses the dark-violet developer template (Geist, glowing edges, rounded cards, eyebrow labels). The Ubuntu OS simulator (`src/components/ubuntu/**`, `UbuntuOS.jsx`, `Terminal.jsx`) is a separate, authentic Ubuntu world and is out of scope for this document.
keyCharacteristics: Matte board black with two warmer layers; copper as the single active colour.
Archivo expanded (wdth 125) semibold for display; Chivo Mono only for data.
2px pads everywhere; full circles reserved for vias and status dots.
Hairline section boundaries and a margin trace that ties the page together.
Fiducial corner marks on images and covers.
Flat at rest; motion is short and decelerating.

rules.name: The One Metal Rule
rules.body: Copper is the only chromatic colour in the interface. Brand colours appear only on a tech icon while it is hovered.

rules.name: The One Filled Pad Rule
rules.body: A screen carries at most one copper-filled action (the hero "Ver proyectos", the contact email pad). Everything else is an outline or a ghost.

rules.name: The Silkscreen Carries Data Rule
rules.body: Mono is used for real data: counts, dates, local time, last push, key hints. If the text is a category name or a section label, it is not silkscreen and should not exist as a kicker.

rules.name: The Wide Voice Rule
rules.body: The 125% width is for display and headline only. Body, titles, and labels stay at normal width.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No blurred coloured shadows, no backdrop-filter glass, no glowing edges. Copper shows up as a solid line, fill, or ring.

dos: Do use 2px corners on every rectangular element, and keep circles for vias, status dots, and flow nodes.
Do keep copper as the only active colour and show at most one copper-filled pad per screen.
Do make every mono annotation carry live or factual data (a count, time, date, or last push).
Do set display and section headings in Archivo at wdth 125 and weight 600 with tight negative tracking.
Do separate sections with a full-width hairline, and frame images with fiducials.
Do ease with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` and collapse motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use glows, blurred coloured shadows, or backdrop-filter glass. Ambient drop shadows belong on true overlays only.
Don't add eyebrow or kicker labels above headings. A silkscreen line that names a category instead of carrying data is a kicker.
Don't round cards, buttons, or tags beyond 2px, or turn them into pills.
Don't introduce a second accent hue. Brand colours live only on hovered tech icons.
Don't use Geist or a system display face for headings.
Don't apply this system to the Ubuntu OS simulator, which keeps its own Ubuntu world.
